grades.reason: Directly explains that an unlinked file remains alive through its open descriptor until the descriptor is closed or the process exits.

grades.quote: The operating system removes the file when it no longer has any names and is no longer in use by any process. (An open file can continue to exist without any names, as you can demonstrate in Exploration Project 8.10.)
grades.reason: Directly explains why unlinking does not destroy an open file, allowing continued access.
